responsibility: Defines the stabs-in-COFF debugging configuration used by COFF targets that support -gstabs. It enables DBX debugging info, usually makes it the preferred format, and sets the stabs emission conventions needed for embedded COFF sections: function-relative block and line records, function-first ordering, N_BINCL usage, unlimited continuation length, and an explicit trailing null N_SO to mark object-file boundaries. This is a target configuration fragment for debug-format conventions, not code that emits symbols directly.
